title: Conditions of Commission Accrual and Payout Under the Vending Services Program
content:
1. Commission under the Vending Services Program accrues machine by machine on gross sales for the statement period, after card processing at the percentage printed against the programme has been deducted, at the commission percentage printed against the programme as lifted by the portfolio band.
2. The net sales on which commission is taken are the machine's gross sales for the period less card processing at that percentage, rounded to two decimal places; the commission is that rounded figure at the commission percentage, itself rounded to two decimal places.
3. A machine whose sales for the period fall below the commission threshold printed against the programme accrues no commission at all, and its sales are not pooled with other machines to reach the threshold.
4. Where the whole estate's commission for a period falls below the minimum payout printed against the programme, nothing is paid out and the accrual is carried into the next period until the minimum is reached.
5. Commission is accrued or paid while the agreement stands active, suspended or closed, because a closed estate still has a final period to settle and a suspended one still has earlier periods outstanding. The standing of the agreement is read from the vending agreement record itself before the accrual or the payment is made.
6. Commission is paid out no later than the commission payment window, counted in calendar days from the day the statement period closes.
7. Payment window days are counted as calendar days from the day after the statement period closes, every day of the week counts, and a payment made on the boundary day itself is in time; calendar days are never converted into full 24-hour periods.
8. Commission is never netted against what the client owes on a vending statement; the two move separately, so a client in arrears still receives their commission.
9. Where a machine is removed part way through a period, commission accrues on the sales it made up to the day of removal and no further.

### The order in which the figure is built (hypothetical figures)

Take one machine with gross sales of 855.55 for the statement period, a card processing charge of 2.50 percent and a commission percentage, as lifted by the portfolio band, of 8.50 percent. Card processing is deducted first: gross sales of 855.55 less 2.50 percent of that figure gives 834.16125, which rounds to 834.16. The commission percentage is then taken on that rounded figure: 8.50 percent of 834.16 gives 70.9036, which rounds to 70.90. The base the commission percentage is taken on is the rounded net figure, and the rounding falls at each of those two points. The sales and the percentages chosen here are illustrative and are not programme figures.

### The two floors distinguished

The per-machine floor and the payout floor are separate conditions on separate quantities. The first is read machine by machine against the period's sales on that machine: a machine below it accrues nothing, and a second machine's sales cannot be added to it to carry it over. The second is read on the whole estate's commission for the period: where it is not reached, nothing leaves, and the accrual stands to the next period, and to the period after that where needed, until the minimum is reached.

### The payment window at its boundary (hypothetical dates)

Where a statement period closes on a given day, the window runs in calendar days from the day after that, counting weekdays, weekends and holidays alike. A payment made on the last day of the window is in time, because the boundary day itself is in time. A payment made on the day after the window closes is late. The window is never read as a number of full 24-hour periods measured from a moment in the day.

### The standing of the agreement

| Standing of the vending agreement | Commission may be accrued or paid |
| --- | --- |
| Active | yes |
| Suspended | yes |
| Closed | yes |
| Proposed | no |
